question: Discuss the causes of labour (employee) turnover and the steps that can be taken to reduce it.
sources: Employee cost: labour turnover, its causes and remedial steps

points.label: Meaning
points.description: Labour turnover is the rate at which employees leave the organisation and are replaced during a period.
points.basis: Employee cost: meaning of labour turnover

points.label: Personal causes
points.description: Employees leave for personal reasons such as a better job elsewhere, family problems, ill health or moving to another place.
points.basis: Employee cost: causes of labour turnover

points.label: Unavoidable causes
points.description: Some leaving cannot be avoided, such as retirement, death, disablement, seasonal work ending or discharge for misconduct.
points.basis: Employee cost: causes of labour turnover

points.label: Avoidable causes
points.description: Some leaving can be avoided, such as low pay, poor working conditions, no chance of promotion and bad relations with supervisors.
points.basis: Employee cost: causes of labour turnover

points.label: Steps to reduce it
points.description: Careful selection and training, fair pay and working conditions, a clear promotion policy, welfare schemes and exit interviews to find and remove the reasons for leaving.
points.basis: Employee cost: remedial steps for labour turnover
